summary: The initial V3-IMPROVE-01.1 design required ordinary and cross-repository evaluation without inventing workloads; its later user-selected finite trial accepts the recorded V3 source cohort with benefit inconclusive. Public #4516 comments 6193021836/6193248972/6193359821/6193443268/6193512676/6193555735 record a source cohort prospectively selected at 13:18:33 UTC on 2026-10-15, candidate delivery at 13:29:35, independent source PASS at 13:34:57, owner-reported ordinary unprotected host landing at 13:36:40 and bounded programme integration audit at 13:42:15. Retain the first oversized-negative-row fixture transport failure and its correction without widening the production document bound. Candidate delivery took 11m02s elapsed from enrollment; this is not active effort or runner cost. The completion receipt closes the source window at 13:42:15 and reports owner-measured 111.14s initial owner-mail discovery latency, 0.47/0.52s failed/passing test processes and 28.47s first failure to subsequent pass. Programme hash-verified the restricted summary, not independently timed execution. Failure-to-pass does not measure first useful diagnosis. Missing comparable baseline, whole-family effort, complete queue/execution split and exact failure/diagnosis timestamps prevent a savings or faster-diagnosis conclusion. Programme verified supplied Git/source equivalence and hash-bound test transcript; private remote currentness and actual host execution remain owner-reported. Public receipts are at https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516; private source/evidence remains restricted. The source route is retained with comparative benefit inconclusive. No unstarted ordinary cohort is yet selected, and second-workload admission remains unresolved. Pure source review and manual evidence handoff do not satisfy the separately accepted installed no-human lifecycle gate or close V3. The later scope decision closes only the finite V3-IMPROVE-01 trial and .1 source contribution, accepts the one-workload profile, makes further ordinary comparison and second workload conditional on explicit selection/genuine ready work, and leaves named native, publication and installed adoption transfers open. The cited protected documents define evaluation and installed acceptance, not proof of private deployment.
title: Prospective source cohort preserves failure and missing comparison evidence
